summary: Iteration 7 — compact OAuth icon row + avatar upload validated end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (6 new avatar tests + 7 regression). Frontend: 5 provider circles render in a single horizontal row (all 52x52, aspect 1.00, same y=476), single 'Requires customer configuration' hint below, all 5 testIDs present (google/microsoft/apple/yahoo/sso). Profile screen shows testID='change-avatar-button' wrapping the avatar with a dark teal camera badge bottom-right, and testID='change-avatar-link' rendering 'Change photo' / 'Cambiar foto'. POST /api/auth/avatar returns 401 without bearer, 400 with empty body/empty string, 200 with valid base64 producing a data:image/jpeg;base64,... data URI persisted on user.picture and verified via GET /api/auth/me. Data-URI pass-through path is also handled (no double-wrapping when input already starts with data:).
action_items: (Optional) The provider row's `flex:1 + maxWidth:52 + gap:8` works on 390px width but on very narrow devices (<320px) the circles could overlap the gaps — consider switching to `justifyContent: 'space-between'` without flex:1 or capping with `aspectRatio:1, width:48` instead of flex:1. Visual on 390px is correct.
(Optional) `expo-image-picker` MediaTypeOptions.Images is deprecated in newer SDK 54; switch to `['images']` array. Non-blocking for current SDK 54.0.34.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1175 lines — still over the 700-line guideline; splitting into routers/{auth,contracts,share,evidence,ai}.py would help maintainability. Same comment as iteration 6.

POST /api/auth/avatar correctly enforces auth (401), validates input (400), caps payload at ~3MB to avoid bloating user docs (413), strips/normalizes data: prefix, and re-reads user with _id excluded. Clean implementation.

Frontend changeAvatar() correctly requests media library permission, gates on canceled/null base64, sets uploading state for spinner, and calls refresh() after success so the new picture re-renders immediately.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all login + profile testIDs and visual layout verified)

seed_data_creation: Used existing /api/seed (idempotent). No new seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 added POST /api/auth/avatar (body {image_base64}, returns updated user with picture as data URI) and compacted the 5 OAuth provider buttons into a single horizontal row of 52x52 circles in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx with one shared 'Requires customer configuration' hint. Profile avatar in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx is now tappable (testID='change-avatar-button') with a camera badge (Ionicons 'camera' webfont glyph) and a 'Cambiar foto'/'Change photo' text link (testID='change-avatar-link'). expo-image-picker can't be fully exercised in headless browsers; backend endpoint is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_avatar.py. Demo bearer obtained via POST /api/auth/dev-login. Existing test file test_conexia_clm.py + test_share_links.py remain valid regression suites.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Note: an inline DOM probe for the camera badge icon initially returned False because Ionicons renders as a webfont glyph (single character inside a styled span — no 'svg' or 'camera' substring in innerHTML); visual screenshot confirms the badge renders correctly. This is a probe limitation, not a UI defect.
